# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 089

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 2200–2224, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example individually. I rewrote all 25 gloss/example pairs in natural Hindi. Several previous examples used a different context from the English source, especially `proportion`, `yard`, `tone`, `absence`, `remark`, and `resolve`; these were aligned with the source meanings.

Changed: 25 Hindi gloss/example pairs.

Progress: 2,225/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (25.18%); 6,612 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
